instruction: A candid outdoor photograph with a full shot of a scenic mountain lake. On the left, the blonde woman in a grey hooded coat (R1) stands on a large rock, facing right. On the right, the bearded man in a brown fedora and denim jacket (R2) stands opposite her on the same rock. They stand close, holding both hands and smiling warmly at each other. The background shows the calm water of the lake and snowy mountain cliffs under soft, overcast daylight, maintaining a cool and natural color palette.
